options: A pure substance made of two or more different elements chemically bonded
A mixture of elements that are not bonded
questions.explanation: A compound is a pure substance formed when two or more different elements bond together chemically.
questions.misconception: A mixture has no chemical bonds (you can separate it by filtering), and a single element is not a compound — the compound requires DIFFERENT elements actually bonded.

questions.prompt: Why is sodium (a reactive metal) plus chlorine (a poisonous gas) safe to eat as salt?
options: Bonding gives the elements a new identity — salt has its own properties
The dangerous parts are filtered out
Tiny amounts of poison are harmless
Sodium and chlorine stop existing entirely
questions.explanation: When elements chemically bond, they form a new substance with new properties. Salt is neither a reactive metal nor a poison — it is a brand-new compound.
questions.misconception: The elements do not disappear and the danger is not filtered — the chemical bond TRANSFORMS the elements into a compound whose properties belong only to the compound.

questions.prompt: How is a compound different from a mixture?
options: A compound's elements are chemically bonded; a mixture's are just mixed
A compound can be separated by filtering
questions.explanation: In a compound the elements are chemically bonded and fixed in ratio; in a mixture the parts are simply mixed and can be separated by physical means.
questions.misconception: Mixtures are separable by filtering or picking apart; compounds are NOT — separating a compound requires a chemical reaction to break the bonds.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a compound?
options: Water — H₂O, hydrogen bonded to oxygen
A bucket of sand and salt
questions.explanation: Water is two different elements (hydrogen and oxygen) chemically bonded — a compound. O₂, the sand-salt mix, and pure copper are not compounds.
questions.misconception: O₂ is two of the SAME element (not a compound), a sand-salt mix has no bonds (a mixture), and pure copper is a single element.
